How to get to Mu Cang Chai from Hanoi? Are you looking for a reliable transfer service to travel from Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai Vietnam? Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai Private Car transfer offered by Vietlook Travel is the best option for your travel needs. It is not only a common door-to-door private car ride with an experienced driver but also a sightseeing tour.

Booking our private car transfer from Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai, you can choose the 1 way direct transfer. Otherwise, you can also select a Mu Cang Chai tour from Hanoi by private car with two package options. That is a three-day private car package and a four-day private car package with our experienced driver to explore the beauty of Mu Cang Chai Yen Bai, Vietnam.

Whether you’re a solo traveler, a couple, or a small group, we always provide the best private car service that comfort, convenience, and flexibility in the itinerary to enhance your travel experience. Let’s book our private car from Ha Noi to Mu Cang Chai right now and embark on an unforgettable adventure in northern Vietnam

HANOI TO MU CANG CHAI PRIVATE CAR SERVICE

Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai distance is about 300 kilometers, so it takes us over 7 hours to transfer by car. You can see the Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai map below

You can take a bus from Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai or other vehicles. However, our Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai by private car is the best service since you can say goodbye to the hassle of crowded buses or the limitations of public transportation schedules.

Hanoi Airport/Hotel To Mu Cang Chai Private Car

Following your provided details, such as the number of people, flight number, landing time, and your hotel name/ address in Ha Hoi. Our driver will pick you up at your Hanoi hotel or the arrival gate of Noi Bai International Airport with your full name printed on a welcome board so you can recognize him easily. After greetings, we will start the private car transfer from Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai.

Along the way from Hanoi to Ha Giang, our driver will stop at convenient places for you to drink some Vietnamese coffee, have lunch, and go to the toilets.

When we arrive in Mu Cang Chai, Yen Bai province, our driver will drop you off at your requested place. After that, he will double-check the car to ensure you haven’t forgotten anything and say goodbye to you. We finish the private car Hanoi to Mu Cang Chai.

Hanoi To Mu Cang Chai Tour Package By Car

If you would like to have a high-quality Hanoi private car with an experienced driver to explore all the highlight attractions of Yen Bai province, please contact us via WhatsApp at (+84) 98.339.3588.

With experience in tourism in Vietnam for over 12 years, Vietlook Travel highly recommends the best two itineraries for car hire to Mu Cang Chai from Hanoi as follows:

Option 1: Mu Cang Chai Tour Itinerary 3 Days:

Day 1: Transfer from Hanoi to Nghia Lo town (4 hour transfer). Then, you can rent a bike (optional) or walk around the local village, or visit Suoi Giang tea plantation. After that, overnight in Nghia Lo.

Day 2: We will transfer you from Nghia Lo town to Mu Cang Chai, passing the spectacular Khau Pha Pass and Tu Le town. After that, we trek to visit La Pan Tan, where impressive rice terraces & lovely local villages. Overnight at a homestay or hotel in Mu Cang Chai.

Day 3: Trek to visit Cu Che Nha commune – a renowned place of Mu Cang Chai rice terrace fields. Next, transfer you to Tu Le town, have lunch, and shop in the local market. After all, our driver will transfer you back to Hanoi.

Option 2: Mu Cang Chai Tour Itinerary 4 Days:

Day 1: Hanoi to Nghia Lo town. Then, walking or biking to visit local villages in Muong Lo valley and overnight in Nghia Lo.

Day 2: Nghia Lo town – Mu Cang Chai trekking to La Pan Tan commune – an area with many majestic landscapes of rice terraces and picturesque villages. Overnight in Mu Cang Chai.

Day 3: Trekking from Mu Cang Chai to Cu Che Nha and Lim Mong communes. You will admire the amazing captivation of rice terraces & remote ethnic villages of Black H’mong ethenic people. Then, you will overnight in Tu Le town.

Day 4: Buying local products at Tu Le town. After all, we will drop you off at your hotel in Hanoi city center or Noi Bai International Airport. Vietlook Travel wishes you a fabulous journey with us.
